create_dashboard.name: Create dashboard
create_dashboard.description: Creates the Battman dashboard at /battman, with all of Battman's views, as a normal dashboard you can edit. Does nothing if something is already at /battman: delete it first for a fresh copy.

create_live_activity.name: Create Live Activity automations
create_live_activity.description: Creates any missing Battman Live Activity automations and script from Battman's blueprints. Never changes ones that exist.

migrate_from_smiggles.name: Migrate from Smiggles
migrate_from_smiggles.description: Moves control of the battery from Smiggles to Battman: turns every Smiggles automation off, copies Smiggles' settings, overrides, rules, curves, odometers, helpers and log into Battman's, then puts Battman in charge. Without confirm it's a dry run that shows what it would do.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Off: dry run (shows the plan, changes nothing). On: migrate.

hand_back_to_smiggles.name: Hand back to Smiggles
hand_back_to_smiggles.description: Gives control of the battery back to Smiggles: Battman's engine stops, its values are copied back into Smiggles', and the Smiggles automations that were on are turned back on. Without confirm it's a dry run.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Off: dry run (shows the plan, changes nothing). On: hand back.

map_choice_ignored.title: Battman no longer uses some of your Configure choices

integration_too_old.title: An integration Battman uses needs updating

missing_entities.title: Battman can't find entities it uses

opennem_choose.title: Pick your OpenNEM region
opennem_choose.description: Battman found several OpenNEM region sensors ({regions}) and doesn't know which one its NEM sensors should read. Pick one under Settings → Devices & services → Battman → Configure. Until then the NEM sensors are unavailable.

dashboard_unavailable.title: Battman could not create its dashboard
dashboard_unavailable.description:
Battman could not create its dashboard at /battman ({error}).

Press **Create dashboard** on the Battman device (Settings → Devices & services → Battman), or run the action `battman.create_dashboard`. If it still fails, a Home Assistant update has changed how dashboards are made and Battman needs a fix: report it at {issues_url} with the error above.

missing_dependencies.title: Battman needs other dashboard cards

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: Battman {new} is installed, but Home Assistant is still running Battman {running}. Restart now to finish the update?

live_activity_not_loaded.title: Battman Live Activity automations didn't load
live_activity_not_loaded.description: Battman added {missing} to automations.yaml / scripts.yaml, but Home Assistant didn't load them. Check that configuration.yaml has `automation: !include automations.yaml` and `script: !include scripts.yaml` (they're there by default), then press Create Live Activity automations on the Battman device again.

local_cards.title: Battman is using your own card files
local_cards.description: These Battman cards come from your files in config/{folder}/ instead of the ones Battman ships: {cards}. That folder is for trying out changes; delete a file there to go back to Battman's version.

packages_not_loaded.title: Battman's package files aren't loaded
packages_not_loaded.description:
Battman wrote its template sensors into `{folder}`, but Home Assistant isn't reading that folder, so these don't exist: {missing}.

Add this to `configuration.yaml` (or check the existing `packages:` line uses `!include_dir_named packages`), then restart Home Assistant:

```yaml
homeassistant:
  packages: !include_dir_named packages
```

engine_not_loaded.title: Battman's engine automations didn't load
engine_not_loaded.description: Battman wrote its engine automations and scripts into automations.yaml and scripts.yaml, but Home Assistant didn't load these: {missing}. Check configuration.yaml has `automation: !include automations.yaml` and `script: !include scripts.yaml`, and look in the log for errors.

themes_not_loaded.title: Battman's themes aren't loaded
themes_not_loaded.description:
Battman wrote its themes into `{folder}`, but Home Assistant isn't reading that folder, so {count} Battman themes are missing and Battman's pages show "no theme".

Add this to `configuration.yaml` (or check the existing `themes:` line uses `!include_dir_merge_named themes`), then restart Home Assistant:

```yaml
frontend:
  themes: !include_dir_merge_named themes
```

init.title: Battman
init.description: Nothing to set here: Battman uses Sigen's, Amber's and Solcast's entities by name, and its NEM sensors find their OpenNEM region themselves. If OpenNEM has several regions, pick the one for the NEM sensors below. Saving also clears choices made here by older versions of Battman.

data.opennem: OpenNEM region (several found: pick the one for the NEM sensors)
